name: brand-world-builder
description: 品牌系统到视觉世界的构建器
tagline: Where brand systems become living worlds.
interaction: Users select or upload brand tokens (colors, typography, logo) which the tool synthesizes into a fully navigable 3D visual universe. Each brand element transforms into architectural features, atmospheric lighting, and dynamic textures that users can explore, customize, and export as immersive brand worlds.
